'''May 2000 Newcastle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Newcastle, England in May 2000. It is known from Alex Tennet's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d860">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fire], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 9 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-naboo-regional-2000-into-the-fired860/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' May 2000
* '''Site:''' Newcastle, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
